June 5, 2018 - By Jacob Smith
Rowland & Company Investment Counsel increased its stake in United Natural Foods (UNFI) by 45.29% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rowland & Company Investment Counsel bought 5,720 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.30% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 18,350 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $793.82 million, up from 12,630 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rowland & Company Investment Counsel who had been investing in United Natural Foods for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.36 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $0.34 during the last trading session, reaching $46.8. About 45,796 shares traded. United Natural Foods, Inc. (NASDAQ:UNFI) has risen 13.26% since June 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.69% the S&P500.
